cast.name: UV Rays
cast.description: small angry golden-orange sun-ray villain (with White Cast and Dullness at his side) attacking the woman's cheek; smug, sneering, gloating cartoon-villain voice, should sound menacing and theatrical

cast.name: Judge DERMDOC Tube
cast.description: the white DERMDOC Ultra Violet sunscreen tube as the courtroom judge with a gavel and white-gloved hands; deep, grave, authoritative judge voice, measured and commanding

cast.name: SPF Shield
cast.description: cobalt-blue SPF 50 PA+++ shield character acting as the defence lawyer; confident, punchy, persuasive cartoon lawyer voice

cast.name: Purple Tint
cast.description: lavender droplet witness character; sweet, cheerful, bubbly higher cartoon voice

cast.name: Niacinamide
cast.description: silver-lavender niacinamide character (drawn as a silver droplet in the video) acting as the expert witness; bright, smart, gentle cartoon voice
